criteria.text: 1. Icon strokes: menu icons (eye, pencil, trash) 14px with stroke-width attr 2.5714 = 1.5px rendered; ellipsis trigger 16px with attr 2.25 = 1.5px rendered; light and dark. Eye/pencil show no stroke pixels in the Figma diff.

2. Upward flip (row 10 at 720 and 760 viewports, light+dark): menu above the trigger, bottom 621 vs trigger top 624.5 = 3.5px gap, no overlap, right edges aligned (delta 0). Downward (rows 2 and 9 at 900): 4.5px below, right delta 0. The 0.5px from 4 is whole-pixel rounding of a half-pixel trigger (item 6); Figma itself has 4.5px (trigger bottom 312.5, menu y317). marginTop now 0px.
3. Trash icon reverted to Trash2 in every table (HEAD also imports Trash2); 5 paths with inner lines. Accepted pending-design deviation from the Figma glyph, not a defect.
4. Rows-per-page chevron #6b7280 in light (rgb(107,114,128)), 14px; dark uses the same muted token (#9ca3af). The spec colour row that failed in attempt 01 now passes.
5. Paginator <nav> has border-0! (border-bottom 0px, wrapper 68px); card 598px; cars-list-light, cars-row-selected-light and cars-row-menu-open-light captures are 1288x734 = Figma references.
6. Menu style top/left whole pixels (277/1082 down, 515/1082 up) in every case; menu 175x106 and capture 175x106 = Figma reference.
Open/close states unchanged: switching rows keeps a single aria-expanded trigger (row 6, right delta 0); toggle/outside/Escape clear the open row and trigger fill.

Flows: Detalhes -> Editar, Editar save, Excluir single (dialog + success), bulk delete success/error, page 2, rows per page 20: all renderChecks pass in light and dark, no blocked API calls, no console errors.

Regression: Brands, Customers and Home captures are pixel-identical (0 px) to attempt 01 in both themes; Brands row menu and Home are 0 px vs HEAD; Brands/Customers pages differ from HEAD only by the uncommitted 18px PageHeader (as in attempt 01). The non-card menu keeps HEAD's Lucide defaults (stroke-width 2, Trash2).
Dark theme: flipped and open menus, paginator and rows-per-page readable.

diferencas.motivo: Unchanged from attempt 01: the select hugs its content; label padding 16px and 40px dropdown match Figma, and the 1.47px is the rendered width of '10' (Inter in Chromium vs Figma).

Dimensions now 175x106 = Figma. The 237 px (1.28%) are the Trash2 inner lines (accepted pending-design deviation: no Lucide icon matches the Figma glyph, user has not decided) plus label anti-aliasing; eye and pencil strokes match.
Accepted, pending design decision: deliberately reverted to Trash2 everywhere; no Lucide icon draws the Figma glyph. Reclassified from defeito (attempt 01).

minimas.motivo: Same size as Figma (1288x734). 0.90% pixel delta = Inter anti-aliasing/advance on every text run plus the already-classified accepted deviations (active-page soft tint, 20px checkboxes, select width). No layout shift.
Same size as Figma (1288x734). 0.92% = the cars-list text anti-aliasing and accepted deviations plus menu label anti-aliasing; open row, trigger and menu position match the frame.
Same size as Figma (1288x734). 1.02% = text anti-aliasing plus the accepted selected-row tint, 20px checkbox and PrimeVue red bulk-delete button.
Home is pixel-identical to HEAD and to attempt 01; the 1.03% Figma delta is pre-existing font/anti-aliasing, untouched by this delivery.

notes: Attempt 02 of the second-pass recheck; base HEAD 90c8f9d (baselines reused). All 42 scenarios from attempt 01 were re-run, including visual/scenarios/cars-second-pass.ts.

Measurements: evidence/measure.cjs -> measurements-attempt-02.json, measure2.cjs -> measurements-flip-close-attempt-02.json, new measure3.cjs (flip/drop at 720/760/900, both themes, whole-pixel check, non-card Brands menu) -> measurements-attempt-02-geometry.json.

Attempt 01 defects closed: menu-icon-stroke, menu-flip-overlap, rows-per-page chevron colour, 1px paginator wrapper border (599 -> 598), menu capture 107 -> 106. menu-trash-glyph reclassified as accepted pending-design.

Gap rounding: with the trigger on a half pixel, Math.round gives 4.5px below (= Figma) and 3.5px above. No overlap. If an exact >= 4px is wanted above as well, the upward branch could use Math.floor; optional, not a defect.
